result.title: SWE-VERIFIER: Selective Verification for Cost-Efficient Coding Agents
result.summary: Coding agents spend substantial computation generating actions and processing long interaction histories. Poor action choices can steer agents into low-value states, wasting computation and increasing API costs. Sampling and verifying alternative actions can improve the agent's decisions, but applying this procedure at every step adds substantial overhead. We introduce SWE-Verifier, a lightweight generative model that selectively triggers candidate sampling and verification. It scores the coding agent's proposed action to determine when additional candidate sampling is needed, then ranks the resulting actions before execution. We train SWE-Verifier from Qwen3.5-4B using preference data that groups contrasting actions with their resulting environment observations and rubric-guided teacher scores. Using the mini-swe-agent harness, SWE-Verifier improves resolution from 75.47% to 77.20% on MiniMax-M2.7 at 1.09 times cost and generalizes to DeepSeek-V4-Flash without training on its actions, improving resolution from 72.60% to 74.27% at 1.13 times cost. Across both models, SWE-Verifier verifies fewer than 4% of steps and achieves comparable or higher resolution than the trajectory and all-step baselines at substantially lower cost. These results demonstrate that selective candidate sampling and lightweight verification provide complementary gains in coding-agent performance and inference efficiency. Our model, code, and data are available at https://github.com/zkjzou/SWE-Verifier.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SWE-Verifier：一个轻量生成式模型，为编码 agent 提议的动作打分，据此决定何时触发额外候选采样，并对候选动作排序后再执行，从而避免每步都验证的额外开销；在 mini-swe-agent 上以约 1.1 倍成本小幅提升解题率，且仅验证不到 4% 的步骤。
AI.relevance_reason: 「何时值得追加采样与验证」的选择性门控加候选排序，可能为 LVR 中「何时继续获取证据、何时停止」及计算分配提供可核查的借鉴线索，但其面向代码 agent，与视觉状态和 latent 表示没有直接联系。
